name: Inma no Ai Shita
source:
He defeats the demon lord, and suddenly succubi are lusting for his body!?
This is the story of one such hero, who gets to learn all about the long,
lovey tongues of the former demon lord's concubines...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE310747.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他打倒了魔王，突然间魅魔都觊觎他的身体！？
这是一个这样的英雄的故事，他开始了解所有关于长期、
前魔王妃子们的甜言蜜语……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE310747.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
